namespace SM

noncomputable section
variable {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]

theorem canonicalPosition_val_zero : (canonicalPosition (0 : ZMod n)).val = n - 1 := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  simp [canonicalPosition]

theorem canonicalPosition_val_nonzero (k : ZMod n) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (canonicalPosition k).val = k.val - 1 := by
  have hp := ZMod.val_pos.mpr hk
  have hn := ZMod.val_lt k
  haveI : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨by omega⟩
  change (k - 1).val = k.val - 1
  rw [ZMod.val_sub (by rw [ZMod.val_one]; omega), ZMod.val_one]

/-- Exact numerical label formula for the corresponding parent edge. The
return edge, rather than the soft edge, inherits the parent label's place
in the traversal order, including parent label zero. -/
theorem softParentEdge_natCast (j k : ZMod n) :
    softParentEdge j k = if j = 0 ∨ k.val < j.val then (k.val : ZMod (n + 1))
      else ((k.val + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (n + 1)) := by
  have hn := NeZero.pos n
  have hkn := ZMod.val_lt k
  have hjn := ZMod.val_lt j
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp only [true_or, ite_true]
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst k
      rw [softParentEdge_at_attachment, softNewIndex_physical, canonicalPosition_val_zero]
      have he : n - 1 + 2 = n + 1 := by omega
      rw [he, ZMod.natCast_self, ZMod.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero]
    · rw [softParentEdge_of_ne 0 k hk]
      have hp := ZMod.val_pos.mpr hk
      have he := softOldIndex_physical (0 : ZMod n) (canonicalPosition k)
      rw [boundaryIndex_canonicalPosition, canonicalPosition_val_nonzero k hk,
        canonicalPosition_val_zero] at he
      have hle : k.val - 1 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
      rw [if_pos hle] at he
      have hv : k.val - 1 + 1 = k.val := by omega
      simpa only [hv] using he
  · have hjp := ZMod.val_pos.mpr hj
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      simp only [hj, false_or, lt_self_iff_false, ite_false]
      rw [softParentEdge_at_attachment, softNewIndex_physical, canonicalPosition_val_nonzero j hj]
      have hv : j.val - 1 + 2 = j.val + 1 := by omega
      rw [hv]
    · rw [softParentEdge_of_ne j k hkj]
      have he := softOldIndex_physical j (canonicalPosition k)
      rw [boundaryIndex_canonicalPosition, canonicalPosition_val_nonzero j hj] at he
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · subst k
        rw [canonicalPosition_val_zero] at he
        have hgt : ¬ n - 1 ≤ j.val - 1 := by omega
        rw [if_neg hgt] at he
        have hv : n - 1 + 2 = n + 1 := by omega
        simp only [hv, ZMod.natCast_self] at he
        simp only [hj, false_or, ZMod.val_zero, hjp, ite_true, Nat.cast_zero]
        exact he
      · have hkp := ZMod.val_pos.mpr hk
        have hne : k.val ≠ j.val := fun h => hkj (ZMod.val_injective n h)
        rw [canonicalPosition_val_nonzero k hk] at he
        by_cases hlt : k.val < j.val
        · have hle : k.val - 1 ≤ j.val - 1 := by omega
          have hv : k.val - 1 + 1 = k.val := by omega
          simpa only [hj, false_or, hlt, ite_true, hle, hv] using he
        · have hgt : ¬ k.val - 1 ≤ j.val - 1 := by omega
          have hv : k.val - 1 + 2 = k.val + 1 := by omega
          simpa only [hj, false_or, hlt, ite_false, hgt, hv] using he

theorem softParentEdge_val (j k : ZMod n) :
    (softParentEdge j k).val = if j = 0 ∨ k.val < j.val then k.val else k.val + 1 := by
  rw [softParentEdge_natCast]
  split_ifs
  · exact ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by have := ZMod.val_lt k; omega)
  · exact ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by have := ZMod.val_lt k; omega)

/-- Unlike a general cyclic relabelling, this parent-edge correspondence
preserves the actual numerical traversal cut, even when inserting after
source label n. This supports equality of inherited sorted visit lists. -/
theorem softParentEdge_val_lt_iff (j k l : ZMod n) :
    (softParentEdge j k).val < (softParentEdge j l).val ↔ k.val < l.val := by
  rw [softParentEdge_val, softParentEdge_val]
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · simp only [hj, true_or, ite_true]
  · simp only [hj, false_or]
    split_ifs <;> omega

theorem softParentEdge_val_le_iff (j k l : ZMod n) :
    (softParentEdge j k).val ≤ (softParentEdge j l).val ↔ k.val ≤ l.val := by
  simpa only [not_lt] using not_congr (softParentEdge_val_lt_iff j l k)

theorem softParentEdge_zero (j : ZMod n) : softParentEdge j 0 = 0 := by
  apply ZMod.val_injective
  rw [softParentEdge_val, ZMod.val_zero]
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · simp only [hj, true_or, ite_true, ZMod.val_zero]
  · have hp := ZMod.val_pos.mpr hj
    simp only [hj, false_or, ZMod.val_zero, hp, ite_true]

end
end SM
evidence.root_log_limit: The successful root log prints seven axiom traces, not full elaborated types for these declarations. Full source statements, section context and proofs are bound by the exact frozen body/prototype bytes. No reviewer elaboration or global canonical audit was run.

findings: canonicalPosition is defined as the value of k-1 in ZMod n. Residue zero represents the final source physical label n and has position n-1. For k!=0, k.val>0 and k.val<n imply n>1; ordinary subtraction by one is therefore valid and gives k.val-1. The temporary Fact(1<n) is derived inside this nonzero-label proof, not imposed as a global premise.

The numerical formula is obtained from the actual physical insertion maps, not from an abstract monotone substitute. For j=0, the return edge at the appended newborn has enlarged label n+1, hence residue zero, while every other parent label remains unchanged. For nonzero j, the return edge corresponding to k=j receives j.val+1; positive labels below j retain their values; later positive labels increase by one.

The k=0 branch with j!=0 is treated separately: the old last physical label moves to the enlarged last physical label n+1, again residue zero. It therefore belongs to the k.val<j.val branch of the formula. This distinction correctly reconciles physical order 1,...,n with numerical order beginning at residue zero.

Both displayed natural-cast branches are strictly below n+1: k.val<n and k.val+1<=n. Thus taking ZMod.val loses no further modular information. The exact value formula is k.val when j=0 or k.val<j.val, and k.val+1 otherwise.

For j=0 the value map is the identity. Otherwise it inserts one gap at the threshold j.val: values below the threshold are unchanged and all values at or above it increase by one. Splitting the two threshold tests proves both directions of strict order; equality and cross-threshold cases remain covered. Non-strict order follows by negating the reversed strict comparison.

softParentEdge_zero follows from the exact value formula and value injectivity. This is specifically the parent-edge correspondence, in which the return edge inherits the original outgoing edge place. It should not be substituted for the old-vertex map, which behaves differently when insertion is after residue zero.

All seven statements quantify over arbitrary j,k,l and every nonzero n, with no geometric hypothesis. At n=1 the only residue is zero: canonicalPosition has value0, the single parent edge maps to the return label0 of ZMod2, and both order equivalences reduce correctly. The nonzero-label theorem has an impossible antecedent there. No source polygon or amplitude at arity1 is asserted.

The canonical traversal key uses the numerical edge value followed by the segment parameter. These helpers provide precisely its different-edge order comparison under the actual insertion map, including cyclic seams. They do not themselves transport same-edge parameters or construct inherited visits, sorted lists or a Cycle equality.

The preserved first failed body differs only by supplying n to ZMod.val_injective in one proof and adding ZMod.val_zero to the final simplification. Applying exactly these two replacements reproduces the frozen body; replacing that body in the first prototype reproduces the tested prototype. All seven statement texts are unchanged. The failed log retains its errors and sorryAx traces; only root81102 provides the successful evidence.

All seven complete embedded bodies match their current frozen files exactly once. The successful log contains six traces with propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound and one trace with propext and Quot.sound; no extra axiom, sorryAx or native_decide is present.
